changes.evidence: The Void Gambit of Deadpool & Wolverine is a pruned variant from the unmade Gambit film's reality, not the main MCU; Marvel Database files him as Remy LeBeau (Earth-TRN1401).

Villain file for the X-Men: The Last Stand / Days of Future Past Jean Grey, the same person as A:fox-jean-grey (Earth-10005). Null wrongly puts her in Earth-199999; Last Stand and the new 2023 of DoFP are Earth-10005 by the owner's rule.
Villain file for Dark Phoenix's Jean Grey, the same person as A:fox-jean-grey-young (Earth-TRN414). Dark Phoenix is Earth-TRN414 by the owner's rule; null wrongly means Earth-199999.

Alex's record runs from X-Men: First Class through DoFP's 1973 and X-Men: Apocalypse, where he dies; his last stand is in Earth-TRN414 under the owner's rule. This matches the young Charles and young Hank records, which are filed Earth-TRN414 even though they start in First Class. (Marvel Database itself keeps Alexander Summers at Earth-10005, which is why this is medium.)

owner_calls.question: In Dark Phoenix, Charles steps down as dean, gives up the school (Hank renames it) and retires to Paris. Under the rules a retirement is a departure, but the next step is the Deadpool 2 cameo showing him with the X-Men at the mansion. Add a left at Dark Phoenix?
options: Keep as is (X-Men to the end; the Deadpool 2 glimpse shows him still with them)
Add left: ["Dark Phoenix"] (retirement is a departure; the Deadpool 2 glimpse is only a gag cameo, not a rejoin)
owner_calls.evidence: Dark Phoenix: Charles resigns, and the school becomes the Xavier School under Hank. Deadpool 2: he is glimpsed in a room with the X-Men during Deadpool's visit.
